<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binary-data SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Root level comment with entity reference &internal; -->
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction content with &internal;"?>
  <child sub:id="1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <child>&internal;</child> and symbols.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child sub:id="2">&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author-name "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT custom (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<library xmlns="http://example.org/library" xmlns:lib="http://example.org/library/meta">
  <!-- Author metadata section -->
  <book lib:category="fiction">
    <title>XML Parsing Techniques</title>
    <author>&author-name;</author>
    <![CDATA[
      Special notes: <book><title>&author-name;</title></book>
    ]]>
  </book>
</library>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Catalog Item">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Expanded">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY note SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  %markup;
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/catalog" xmlns:cat="http://example.com/catalog">
  <!-- Detailed catalog listing -->
  <item cat:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw description: &extended; & <item> nested.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&extended;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (employee*)>
  <!ELEMENT employee (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY corp "Global Enterprises">
  <!ENTITY % dept-decl "<!ELEMENT department (employee+)>">
  %dept-decl;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<enterprise xmlns="http://example.com/enterprise" xmlns:ent="http://example.com/enterprise/ns">
  <!-- Company structure definition -->
  <?ent-info status="operational"?>
  <department ent:code="D01">
    <employee>
      <![CDATA[
        Employee details for &corp; in CDATA block.
      ]]>
    </employee>
    <employee>&corp; Staff</employee>
  </department>
</enterprise>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY r1 "Record Alpha">
  <!ENTITY r2 "&r1; and Beta">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ent 'MacroValue'>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-config cache="false" timeout="30"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:arc="http://example.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive manifest comment -->
  <?arc-meta author="SystemAdmin"?>
  <record arc:id="A-001">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive entry with entities (&r2;) and raw tags <record/>.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&macro-ent;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (name, price)>
  <!ELEMENT name (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY currency "USD">
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ENTITY def-price '0.00'>">
  %p-ent;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="inventory.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inv" xmlns:inv="http://example.com/inv">
  <!-- Product inventory ledger -->
  <?inv-log action="audit" timestamp="2023-10-01"?>
  <product inv:id="P99">
    <name>
      <![CDATA[
        Widget <Special Edition> ¤cy;
      ]]>
    </name>
    <price>&def-price;</price>
  </product>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-val "Registered Value">
  <!ENTITY % safety "<!-- Parameter entity safely defined -->">
  %safety;
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY bdata SYSTEM "data.bin" NDATA bin>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="backup" data="auto=true"?>
<registry xmlns="http://example.com/reg" xmlns:r="http://example.com/reg/ns">
  <!-- Registry configuration root -->
  <entry r:key="config-key">
    <![CDATA[
      Configuration data containing &e-val; and markup <entry/>.
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <entry>&e-val;</entry>
</registry>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE portfolio [
  <!ELEMENT portfolio (project*)>
  <!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY p-name "Project Omega">
  <!ENTITY % proj-def "<!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>">
  %proj-def;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="print.css" media="print"?>
<portfolio xmlns="http://example.org/portfolio" xmlns:pf="http://example.org/portfolio/ns">
  <!-- Portfolio overview comment block -->
  <?pf-instruction execute="verify"?>
  <project pf:status="complete">
    <![CDATA[
      Summary of &p-name; including <project>&p-name;</project> structures.
    ]]>
  </project>
  <project>&p-name;</project>
</portfolio>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE dashboard [
  <!ELEMENT dashboard (widget*)>
  <!ELEMENT widget (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY w-title "Main Dashboard">
  <!ENTITY % w-macro "<!ENTITY w-sub 'SubWidget'>">
  %w-macro;
  <!NOTATION json SYSTEM "application/json">
  <!ENTITY jdata SYSTEM "data.json" NDATA json>
]>
<?xml-metrics interval="60"?>
<dashboard xmlns="http://example.com/dash" xmlns:d="http://example.com/dash/ns">
  <!-- Dashboard layout configurations -->
  <?d-log level="info"?>
  <widget d:position="top">
    <![CDATA[
      Dashboard CDATA containing &w-title; and <widget>&w-sub;</widget>.
    ]]>
  </widget>
  <widget>&w-sub;</widget>
</dashboard>
```

  <workspace-item>&ws-name;</workspace-item>
</workspace>
